name: Matter.js-Server
description: Open Home Foundation Matter.js Server is a Matter controller server with a Python Matter Server-compatible WebSocket API and a browser dashboard. It is used by Home Assistant Matter integrations and can also run as a standalone self-managed Matter server.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent Matter fabric data, server storage, migration data, and optional logs. Back this path up before migrating from Python Matter Server.

paths.name: Host D-Bus
paths.description: Optional host D-Bus mount used for Bluetooth commissioning with Noble Bindings set to dbus. Set the host path to /run/dbus only if the host has BlueZ running.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Matter.js Server dashboard and WebSocket API port. With host networking, keep this aligned with the PORT variable. Container port: 5580.

variables.name: Storage Path
variables.description: Storage path inside the container. Keep this pointed at the Data mount.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Dashboard and WebSocket server port used inside host networking. Keep this aligned with Web UI Port.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Server logging level: critical, error, warning, info, debug, or verbose.

variables.name: Listen Address
variables.description: Optional IP address or interface name to bind the WebSocket server. Leave blank to bind all interfaces. Interface names can make the upstream health check fail.

variables.name: Primary Interface
variables.description: Optional network interface used for Matter mDNS and link-local communication, for example eth0 or br0. Leave blank for auto-detect.

variables.name: Log File
variables.description: Optional full log file path inside the container, for example /data/logs/matter-server.log. The path must include the filename.

variables.name: Production Mode
variables.description: Force dashboard production mode when running behind a reverse proxy. Use true or false.

variables.name: Disable Dashboard
variables.description: Disable the browser dashboard and keep only the WebSocket API. Use true or false.

variables.name: Disable OTA
variables.description: Disable Matter OTA update functionality. Use true or false.

variables.name: Enable Test Net DCL
variables.description: Also use the test-net Matter Device Certificate Ledger for certificates and OTA updates. Use true or false.

variables.name: Node Options
variables.description: Optional Node.js runtime options, for example --max-old-space-size=512 for larger deployments.

variables.name: Noble Bindings
variables.description: Optional Bluetooth backend. Set to dbus with the Host D-Bus mount for unprivileged host Bluetooth access, or leave blank if not using BLE commissioning. Add BLUETOOTH_ADAPTER manually only when you need to force a numeric HCI adapter ID.
